messages:
Nina (AE): Heads-up — MedPath Health wants a compact assurance quick-pack for the POC. Request list: SOC 2 Type II excerpt (scope + period), ISO 27001 snapshot, a signed pen-test attestation (no raw reports), a one-page control map to HIPAA ePHI categories, and an explanation of Hosted vs Dedicated POC pricing/commit. They also asked whether we can provide our vuln scan cadence and whether Redwood will sign a BAA for POC data. Can we get a single ZIP for their dataroom by EOD tomorrow?
Owen (SE): I can pull the SOC 2 excerpt and draft a short control summary focused on auth, encryption-at-rest/in-transit, logging/retention, and incident response contacts. I’ll note the audit period and auditor.
Harper (Security): I’ll prepare the pen-test attestation template plus an exec summary of the last external test (date, in-scope surface, top findings, remediation status). Confirming they only want an attestation + exec summary, not the full report?
Nina (AE): Correct — they explicitly said no raw reports for the initial packet. If they need more we can route to Sales + Legal.
Harper (Security): Also will add a short paragraph on our vulnerability scanning cadence (weekly authenticated scans, monthly unauthenticated, quarterly 3rd-party scans) and a blurb on KMS key segregation and ephemeral staging creds. Need Legal on signer for the attestation.
Maya (Legal): I can sign the attestation as Head of Legal. Reminder: do not include operational commitments in the attestation. If MedPath asks to alter wording or asks for a BAA, route that to Legal; I can triage. Small wording tweaks I can turn around same day; contracting/BAA will take longer.
Rafi (SRE): I can produce a sanitized network/dataflow diagram and a hosting manifest (region, tenancy, storage encryption). Will redact IPs/hostnames. For delivery we can either upload to the dataroom or provide a presigned S3 link. Example presign (7d): `aws s3 presign s3://redwood-evidence/medpath-poc-quickpack.zip --expires-in 604800`
Owen (SE): Pricing note: Hosted = no reservation, pay-as-you-go (good for exploratory POCs); Dedicated = short reserved capacity (typical 2-week min) + one-time onboarding/setup fee. I’ll create a one-row estimate for low/med/high usage to include in the README.
Harper (Security): Staging scan policy: authenticated scans allowed in scheduled 3-hour windows with 48h notice; require a POC contact alias and a waiver for impact during the window. I’ll add that policy text and contact alias to the README. Also include a line: "Raw pentest reports are only shared under NDA and explicit agreement; we provide exec summary + remediation status in the packet."
StorageBot: Created ticket POC-77421 "MedPath POC assurance quick-pack" assigned to Harper, Owen, Rafi. Due: 2026-01-20.
Nina (AE): Action items: Harper -> attestation + exec summary + vuln cadence + scan policy; Maya -> confirm signer (thanks); Rafi -> sanitized diagram + manifest; Owen -> SOC 2 excerpt + pricing estimate. Aim to upload single ZIP to their dataroom by 16:00 PT tomorrow.
Harper (Security): Will post draft attestation and the exec summary in the ticket by 10:00 PT tomorrow and call out any disclosure limitations.
Maya (Legal): Pre-approving signer language now; will sign the final attestation once posted. If MedPath asks for a BAA, please open a contract request — that will take the usual legal cycle.
Rafi (SRE): Diagram + manifest ETA: tomorrow 12:00 PT, will attach presign fallback if dataroom access is delayed.
Owen (SE): SOC 2 excerpt + pricing row ETA: tomorrow 14:30 PT.
Nina (AE): Thanks all — I’ll confirm NDA/dataroom access with MedPath and let them know we’ll deliver a single ZIP. Ping me immediately if anything blocks. :thumbsup:
Harper (Security): One more note — if MedPath asks for historical remediation tickets tied to the pen-test, do not share tickets; provide a summary of remediation status and closure dates instead.
Nina (AE): Noted. Appreciate the quick turnaround team.
